title: Implement slugify in one module
requirement: Implement `slugify(text)` in `slugger/core.py`. It lowercases the text, replaces each run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with one hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens. Input with no ASCII letters or digits returns an empty string.
invariants: slugify is a pure function of its argument
slugify(slugify(x)) equals slugify(x) for every x
only the standard library is imported
acceptance_criteria: Runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse to one hyphen
Leading and trailing hyphens are stripped
Input with no ASCII letters or digits returns an empty string

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reason: No existing in-tree corpus offers a Python-only single-module task with a one-file legal change surface. The C# corpus under evals/oneshot-vs-shipped needs the dotnet toolchain and the prompt fixtures under evals/reviewer-asymmetry-spike are not executable repositories.
